summary:
New A1/A2 direction with a bounded-liveness endpoint: what a client sees when a stranded leader issues VerifyLeader, with the healthy case as its own control and the fixed execution requested (valid:true).

Harness (draft/assurance_verify_partition.go): MakeCluster(3) with heartbeat, election and leader-lease timeouts all 300ms — the first attempt used a 1s lease and was rejected by the captured config validation with "LeaderLeaseTimeout (1s) cannot be larger than heartbeat timeout (50ms)", which is itself now recorded as a source behaviour (config.go:366-371 inside ValidateConfig). The probe emits verify_control_start, calls VerifyLeader on the healthy leader and emits verify_healthy; then isolates the leader with c.Partition, emits verify_probe_start with the connected-peer count, calls VerifyLeader again, waits on the future from a separate goroutine against a 6s limit, and emits verify_partitioned with completion, elapsed time, error text, state and the wait limit.

Comparisons requested (all protection-flavoured, and both partitioned comparisons share one admission alias that maps 1:1 to a single node, so no scoping trap): the healthy verification succeeds; the isolated leader's verification completes within the client wait limit (no hang); and it reports an error rather than success. Local run of the fixed harness: healthy verification returned nil in 0ms with the node still Leader; after isolation the request completed in 304ms with lease 300ms, error text "leadership lost while committing log", and the node was Follower. Mechanism recorded as a behaviour: VerifyLeader only counts peer replies, so with silent peers the request is resolved by the leader-loop lease check stepping down when fewer than quorumSize voters were contacted within LeaderLeaseTimeout, after which the step-down cleanup answers every pending verification with ErrLeadershipLost (raft.go:1036-1081, api.go:883-893, plus the existing cleanup and vote behaviours).

The investigation stays active with the local operands flagged as non-retained evidence, and its limitations note that the probe isolates rather than crashes the leader, that the lease must not exceed the heartbeat timeout, and that the followers' concurrent election is outside the measured endpoint.
